data.title: 丰川祥子 · 和解后的合奏
data.description: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来；弹奏中她闭了闭眼——「命运未必相同，内心共鸣如一」，这是她学会的、最珍贵的一件事。
data.action: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来
data.camera: wide ensemble shot, keyboard foreground and bandmates visible behind
data.promptProse: Sakiko plays the rehearsal keyboard in the foreground, closing her amber eyes briefly as her former bandmates join the phrase. A vocalist stands beside a microphone, a guitarist and bassist face inward with their instruments, and a drummer keeps time at the rear. The five musicians have distinct hairstyles and separate positions; they share the same rehearsal room and visibly play together. Sakiko wears a cream knit top and blue trousers, with ribbons holding her blue hair. Afternoon window light crosses the keyboard and occupied music stands. An imagined reconciliation rendered as a warm ensemble scene, no lettering.
